name: Vicem Context Baton MCP
description: Local stdio MCP server for cross-agent context handoffs (.vicem/BATON.md) and on-demand AST symbol rehydration (.vicem/ledger.json). Read-only tools (vicem_read_baton, vicem_rehydrate, vicem_check_guard) inherit Guard's policy; vicem_create_baton writes .vicem/BATON.md, .vicem/baton.json, and .vicem/ledger.json after saving a rollback snapshot in .vicem/snapshots/, so it requires review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use vicem_read_baton, vicem_rehydrate, and vicem_check_guard for read-only inspection; none of them modify workspace files or make network calls.

Keep vicem_create_baton on Review: it harvests local session transcripts and git diff state and overwrites .vicem/BATON.md, .vicem/baton.json, and .vicem/ledger.json (after saving a rollback snapshot under .vicem/snapshots/).
Run vicem_check_guard before committing handed-off edits to verify that no skeleton placeholders ({ ... }, /* ... */, pass) or redacted secret tokens were written to tracked files.
